summary: Post-pit-exit cleanup. Fills a sentinel slot, reads the tire-change flag byte, increments a tire-change counter when the flag is clear, clears timeOfNextExit for race sessions (SessionType == 7), and sets the next pit exit timestamp to session time + 4.0. Returns the tire-change flag byte.

operations.description: Call SentinelSlotFill on a slot address derived from this (this + 0x4034).
Read the tire-change flag byte at this + 0x4584 and hold it as the return value.
If the tire-change flag byte is zero, increment the tire-change counter dword at this + 0x45E0.
If SessionType global dword_7C56A4 equals 7, clear this + 0x4534 (timeOfNextExit).
Set this + 0x447C (next pit exit timestamp) to dbl_8AFEA0 (session time) + 4.0.
Return the saved tire-change flag byte.
